description: Liste des zones blanches centres-bourgs d'Occitanie (téléphonie mobile) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Préfecture de la région Occitanie. Historical Between 2003 and 2008, 3310 town centres were identified as without mobile coverage. To date, only 3 municipalities of Occitanie from this list are not covered (2 in Ariège and 1 in the Gard). Two new censuses of town centres in white areas were carried out by the state with mobile operators and ... Coverage: Préfecture de la région Occitanie. The portal shows the English title as "List of white areas centre-bourgs of Occitanie (mobile phone)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Préfecture de la région Occitanie. Its keywords include amenagement-numerique, zone-blanche, infrastructure, telephonie-mobile. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ODS, JSON. The listing shows 2017-10-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
